correctness.rationale: The 12-word witness is directly verified. The upper bound exhausts all 13-word candidates after a complete automorphism reduction: one word is normalized to \(0000\), and a second is reduced by Hamming weight to four canonical cases. Two exact recursions reconstruct and avoid all \(18{,}792\) forbidden triples; both refute every canonical case.

value.rationale: The ternary case is the smallest nonbinary alphabet for the length-four, coalition-two extremal problem. A directly relevant 2020 paper singled it out with a 12-word construction but did not prove optimality, while archive-era general constructions give a smaller generic lower bound at this alphabet size. The exact closure therefore gives a natural benchmark for structural bounds rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
